column4: cleat#1963: verifies claim Step 4's LOCK_TIMEOUT liveness fix (a genuinely-locked row bounds Step 4's UPDATE and returns cleanly instead of blocking indefinitely), SQL Server only -- this job sets CLEAT_TEST_DB (postgres) but no CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL, so the test skips here on every run. Measured: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL go test ./engine/ -run TestMSSQLClaimStep4LockTimeoutBoundsAGenuinelyLockedRow -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly one.
